customManagers.description: Forgejo test-instance version pinned outside the workflow (Makefile, README, main_test.go). The line after the marker comment holds the version.

packageRules.description: Require dashboard approval for Go major version updates
Pin Forgejo Actions workflow digests, auto-update minor/patch
Require dashboard approval for major Actions updates only

Forgejo test instance: always track the newest release tag (https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/tags; the docker datasource exposes the same tags plus the image digest). One PR touching every reference (workflow service image, Makefile, README, main_test.go), majors included, no separate minor/patch PR, no dashboard approval; CI on the PR decides. Must stay after the github-actions major rule above.
